# Data dictionary

## Raw (gitignored, generated by `scripts/prepare_data.py`)

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `dolly_subset.jsonl` | All formatted examples (train + val) — one JSON object per line: `{"text": "<prompt>"}` |
| `dolly_train.jsonl` | Train split (90% of subset) |
| `dolly_val.jsonl` | Validation split (10%) |
| `dolly_provenance.txt` | Dataset source + license note |

## Prompt template

Each example is formatted as:

```
### Instruction
<instruction>

### Context            <- only when the row has context
<context>

### Response
<response>
```

The model learns to continue text after `### Response\n`.

## Committed sample

`data/samples/dolly_sample.jsonl` — 3 formatted examples (first of the seeded subset) so the template and data shape are visible without downloading anything. Full provenance in the project README.
